description: What changed between two versions of one NEAR product: every release in between with the removals and deprecations its notes announce, lines marked breaking, and nearcore's CODE_COLOR, PROTOCOL_UPGRADE and SECURITY_UPGRADE flags. Products: nearcore, near-sdk, near-api-js, near-api, near-cli-rs, cargo-near, near-workspaces, near-jsonrpc-client, mpc, near-sdk-js. Use when upgrading: "what breaks moving near-api-js from 5.1.0 to 7.4.0?".

from_version.description: The version you are on, e.g. "5.1.0".

product.description: One of: nearcore, near-sdk, near-api-js, near-api, near-cli-rs, cargo-near, near-workspaces, near-jsonrpc-client, mpc, near-sdk-js; or its GitHub repo, e.g. "near/near-api-js".

to_version.description: The version you move to, e.g. "7.4.0". A prerelease target includes prereleases.

name: get_breaking_changes
